## Expert Talk on “IPR Basics for Innovation and Entrepreneurs” Organized at MGIT

TheDepartment of Civil Engineering, in association with theInstitute Innovation Council (IIC), Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), organized anExpert Talkon30th January 2026.
The session was delivered byDr. C. V. Siva Rama Prasad, Associate Professor,Malla Reddy University, on the topic“IPR Basics for Innovation and Entrepreneurs.”
During the talk, the speaker emphasized theimportance of Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)for UG and PG engineering students in protecting and valuing their innovative ideas. He explained key concepts related topatents, copyrights, trademarks, and design rights, highlighting how these mechanisms prevent unauthorized copying and enable legal ownership, publication, and commercialization of innovations.
Dr. Siva Rama Prasad also stressed thatIPR awareness encourages students to move beyond academic projects and prototypes, enabling them to transform technical solutions intostartups, products, and meaningful research outcomes. The session provided practical insights into how innovation combined with IPR knowledge can contribute to entrepreneurship and industry relevance.
The expert talk was informative and interactive, benefiting students and faculty members by enhancing their understanding of innovation protection and entrepreneurial pathways.
